decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the firm's thermoforming portfolio for dental labs, and the product has its own page, which signals active support.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a core material for aligners and splints with steady recurring demand in the firm's established dental lab channel.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website, but it is a cheap complementary consumable for lab workflows that costs little to keep in the range.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the move toward digital scanning workflows, which matches the firm's digital manufacturing strategy.
Custom earmolds rest on the firm's core custom-device manufacturing skills and serve its hearing-care retail customers.
Custom hearing protection uses the same production base as the earmold line and serves a stable occupational and consumer market.
